column1: 1 The minimum lot area per dwelling unit listed in this table is for the purpose of computing the maximum number of detached single-family dwelling units that may be permitted on-site. Minimum lot sizes are as established in § 225-74 . Maximum permitted residential densities for other types of dwellings units can be determined from the minimum lot size listed in § 225-74 , or in some cases by reviewing Part 8 , Special Standards for Particular Uses.
